intro: A man stands by the path. He is of average height. Average build. His hair is a color.
speaker: Norman Al Guy
introDialogue: Oh! You noticed me. Most people's eyes just… slide right off.$I'm Norman Al Guy. I collect Normal-type Pokémon. And you—$FIVE pure Normal-types?! No gimmicks, no second typings, no legendary crutches?$You… you GET it. The others call it boring. I call it UNDILUTED.
title: The Normal One
description: The most average man you have ever seen is nearly vibrating with excitement over your team composition. He offers a reward for your devotion to @[TOOLTIP_TITLE]{the purest of all types}: a legendary item of profound normalcy, or a companion from his personal collection.

1.label: Accept an Item
1.tooltip: (+) Choose one of three one-of-a-kind Normal-type items
1.selected: An item that embodies normalcy so completely it transcends it. Use it well.

2.label: Accept a Companion
2.selected: This one's from my personal collection. Perfectly normal. Devastatingly so.

3.label: Decline Politely
3.selected: Ah. Well. That's… normal, I suppose. Most people walk away. It's fine. This is fine.

outro: You look back. You can no longer tell which person he was. Perhaps that's the point.
